decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (024-PE-XX-00-DR-A-0004 Rev P01, 024-PE-XX-00-GF-A-002 Rev P01, 024-PE-XX-GF-DR-A-003 Rev P01, 024-PE-XX-GF-DR-A-0009 Rev P01, 024-PE-XX-XX-DR-A-005 Rev P01, 024-PE-XX-XX-DR-A-012 Rev P01 (received 24/07/2013)
024-PE-XX-00-DR-A-010 P02 (received 19/09/2013)
024-PE-XX-00-DR-A-008 Rev C01 (received 08/10/2013)
024-PE-XX-XX-DR-A-0902 C01 (received 09/10/2013)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Excluding demolition and ground preperation, no development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension and full details and samples of the proposed canopy hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The building shall not be occupied until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  These works shall then be carried out within three months of the occupation of the development.  These details shall include means of enclosure; hard surfacing material and minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, play equipment, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc). Soft landscape works shall include planting plans;  schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate and an implementation programme.
Condition : 5 - The measures contained in the Travel Plan shall be implemented as approved.
Condition : 6 - The cycle storage shall be implemented as approved prior to the occupation of the extensions.

Condition : 7 - The electric car charging point shall be provided as specified in the application prior to the occupation of the buildings.  The electric car charging point shall then be maintained in working order for as long as the development remains in existence.
Condition : 8 - The development shall be carried out and used in accordance with the Delivery and Servicing Plan and Construction Logistics Plan submitted with the application.

Condition : 9 - Unless otherwise agreed in writing by the LPA the gas protection membrane system detailed in drawing 024-PE-XX-XX-DR-A-0902 Rev C01 and types of tanking/damp proofing details received 09/10/2013 shall be installed as approved.

Condition : 10 - Before the development hereby permitted commences:
a.	A scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval.  The scheme shall account for the following issues
-	Details of how excavated material is to be disposed of;
-	Details of clean soil to be imported and how its quality will be validated.
   During the course of the development:
b.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
   Before the development is first brought into use:
c.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in condition 9 and clauses a) and b) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
description: Installation of additional hardstanding to form a car parking area and erection of two single storey rear extensions to create 5 new classrooms and a staffroom to increase the capacity of the school to 4 forms of entry
